title: LEVEL UP YOUR GAME: THE ULTIMATE XP & PROGRESSION GUIDE
excerpt: Ready to make every message, voice session, and study discussion count? Experience Points (XP) track your activity across BrainlyHQ and unlock powerful tier multipliers, valuable loot drops, and higher coin rewards. Learn how XP calculation works and discover the best strategies to level up faster.
body:
## How XP Works at BrainlyHQ

Your Experience Points (XP) represent your overall engagement across the BrainlyHQ community. The Brainly Core bot automatically tracks your activity and binds your XP directly to your server profile.

Earning XP is not just about bragging rights - higher levels directly increase your chances of earning loot drops and grant substantial Brainly Coin rewards at key milestones.

## Top Ways to Earn Base XP

Every interaction on the server contributes to your progression, but some activities reward you more than others:

- Standard Chat Messages: Earn 4 XP for every standard message sent in active discussion channels.
- Detailed Messages: Writing a comprehensive, thoughtful message of more than 200 characters earns 6 XP.
- Messages with Attachments: Sharing helpful screenshots, notes, or files awards a 1.5x XP multiplier on your message.
- Active Voice Channels: Spending time in a voice channel with your microphone turned on earns you 5 XP per minute.
- Edu-Posts Bonus: Participating in educational discussions under posts on `#edu-posts` doubles the XP you earn!

## Boosters and Pets: Accelerate Your Growth

If you want to speed up your progression, you can use specialized boosters and companion pets:

- Level Boosters: Reaching higher level tiers automatically grants passive multiplier boosts, scaling from the Bronze Level Booster (1.3x XP) all the way to the Ascendant Level Booster (2.6x XP).
- Fast Boosts: Temporary consumables like the Gold (3 XP), Platinum (6 XP), and Diamond Fast Boost (9 XP) give you rapid progression surges.
- Companion Pets: Equipping Sally, the curious cat pet, activates the Experience ability, increasing all XP earned from economy and progress systems by 1.3x.

![](/assets/images/blog/trophy.png)

## Milestone Rewards and Loot-Drop Rates

As your level climbs, your standing in the server becomes more rewarding. Here is a snapshot of what you unlock at key milestones:

- Level 5: 8 Coins reward with a 2.00% base loot-drop chance.
- Level 15: 32 Coins reward with a 4.00% base loot-drop chance.
- Level 30: 256 Coins reward with a 9.00% base loot-drop chance.
- Level 50 (Max Tier): 1,500 Coins reward with a top-tier 18.00% loot-drop chance.

Higher levels give you better odds for reward crates and special server perks. 
**Jump into the chat, share your knowledge in the study channels, and watch your rank grow!**
